sections.title: DressApp: My DressApp Closet Book
sections.subtitle: A Super Simple Guide to Managing Your Clothes & Outfits
sections.overview_p1: Welcome to DressApp! This is a cutting-edge app that lets you build your very own digital clothes closet.
sections.overview_p2: Imagine taking pictures of all your shirts, pants, skirts, and shoes, and putting them into a magical book. Once they are inside, a professional and experienced stylist looks at your clothes, checks the weather outside, and helps you pick what to wear for any occasion!
sections.overview_p3: You can also dress up your own character (avatar), trade or share clothes with friends, and see how much your closet is worth.
sections.prereq_p1: To start working with DressApp, you will need:
sections.prereq_item1: A computer, tablet, or phone with a web browser.
sections.prereq_item2: A camera on your device to snap photos of your clothes.
sections.prereq_item3: A microphone on your device so you can talk to your professional AI Stylist.
sections.prereq_item4: A Gemini API Key. Get it for free on Google AI Studio (https://aistudio.google.com/).
sections.add_clothes_p1: Let's put your physical clothes into your digital closet!
sections.add_clothes_step1: Open DressApp and click the Add Item button.
sections.add_clothes_step2: Click Take Photo to take a picture of your garment, click Upload Photos if you already have a picture saved, click Import URL to grab a garment from an online shop link, or click Upload Receipt to parse a PDF or image receipt from your purchases.
sections.add_clothes_step3: The app checks if you already added this item before. If you did, a pop-up window will ask if you want to skip it.
sections.add_clothes_step4: If it's a new item, wait 5 seconds. The app will magically remove the background, crop the clothing item, and extract its attributes.
sections.add_clothes_step5: Check the results! You can choose the type of clothing (like shirt or pants). If the cutout shape looks wrong, changing the clothing type category will fix it.
sections.add_clothes_step6: Click the Save button. Now the item is saved in your closet grid!
sections.stylist_title: Talking to Your professional AI Stylist
sections.stylist_p1: You have a professional AI stylist who gives you advice on what to wear. You can talk to it just like a friend!
sections.stylist_step1: Go to the AI Stylist screen.
sections.stylist_step3: Ask a question out loud, like: 'What matches my blue jeans for a rainy school day?'
sections.stylist_step4: You will see your words appear on the screen as you talk.
sections.stylist_step5: If the voice typing doesn't work, the app will record your voice and send it to the Stylist.
sections.stylist_step6: The Stylist will read the weather, check what clothes are in your closet, and suggest an outfit.
sections.stylist_step7: The Stylist will speak back to you! Click Play Reply to hear the advice again.
sections.profile_p1: Your Profile page has different settings sections. Here is why each section is important:
sections.profile_item1_desc: This is where you put your profile photo. It lets DressApp draw your character avatar. You will see the outfits on your character avatar.
sections.profile_item2_desc: It tells the Stylist what kind of clothes you like to wear. If you prefer modest clothes, you can toggle that option. The Stylist will only suggest outfits that make you feel comfortable.
sections.profile_item3_desc: Damit weiß DressApp, wer Sie sind, und kann Sie mit Namen begrüßen. Die App verwendet Ihren Namen in Begrüßungsbenachrichtigungen und E-Mails. Ihre Telefonnummer wird für Push-Benachrichtigungen verwendet. Konfigurieren Sie Ihre Telefonnummer im Bereich CONTACT.
sections.profile_item4_desc: Es hilft DressApp, Kleidung zu finden, die Ihnen passt. Wenn Sie neu sind, tragen Sie Ihre Größe, Ihr Gewicht, Ihren Taillenumfang und Ihre Fußlänge ein, und die App berechnet die verbleibenden 6 Maße für Sie. Wenn Sie zum Bearbeiten zurückkehren, berechnet jede Änderung an den 4 Basiswerten den Rest sofort neu.
sections.profile_item5_desc: It helps the Stylist understand what you do every day (like a student, office worker, lawyer, or party) and customizes trend suggestions that suit you best.
sections.profile_item6_desc: it's crucial to have a Gemini (or other model of your choice) API key. Without it, DressApp cannot perform its magic. You have to select a multi-modal AI model.
sections.profile_item7_desc: It will give you the perfect outfit for the next day based on your calendar, the weather, and your style. The Stylist will rotate your closet for a perfect outfit every day! Saving the frustration of standing in front of the closet and trying to figure out what to wear. It will help you use all of the items in your closet.
sections.profile_item8_desc: It matches your outfits to your daily activities, checking if you have soccer practice, a date, or an important meeting.
sections.profile_item9_desc: It makes sure the Stylist knows the weather where you live, so it won't suggest a thick coat on a hot summer day.
sections.profile_item10_desc: It lets you pick how the Stylist speaks to you and changes the language.
sections.profile_item11_desc: It lets you share the app with friends. For every friend who signs up using your link, you get +10 extra slots in your closet.
sections.stats_p1: See how much your closet is worth and which items are your favorites!
sections.stats_worth: Closet Worth: How much money all your clothes cost together.
sections.stats_util: Closet Utilization: The percentage of clothes you have worn at least once.
sections.stats_cpw: Cost-per-Wear: How cheap or expensive a garment is based on how many times you wore it.
sections.stats_palette: Color Palette Breakdown: Stats showing your wardrobe's colors, materials, and categories breakdown.
sections.planner_p1: The Outfit Planner helps you layer, arrange, and evaluate your styling selections:
sections.planner_item1_desc: Layer and combine clothes dynamically on your custom character avatar to build your outfit layout.
sections.planner_item2_desc: If you are wearing a jacket or outerwear over a shirt, the interface renders a side-by-side view (one avatar showing the outerwear, one without) so you can review both layers simultaneously.
sections.planner_item3_desc: Click directly on any clothing item on your avatar's body to open its dedicated details pane.
sections.planner_item4_desc: Displays progress bars grading how well your outfit matches current weather alerts, formality rules, and color palette guidelines.
sections.suitcase_step1: Go to the Suitcase page and fill out your trip details (where you are going, when, and what you will do).
sections.suitcase_step2: The Stylist will show you a daily packing checklist.
sections.suitcase_step3: If the weather is going to rain, the Stylist will warn you if you forgot an umbrella or raincoat, and will suggest options.
sections.suitcase_step4: You can type in the chat to tell the Stylist to change things (e.g. 'Pack a casual outfit for day 2').
sections.suitcase_step5: Click Approve Suitcase to lock in your list!
sections.market_p1: Share, donate, rent, or trade clothes with other users in your area!
sections.market_step1: Create a Listing: Open an item's detail page, select Edit Intent, and choose For Sale, Rent, Swap, or Donate.
sections.market_step2: Try-On Sandbox: Buyers can test-fit your listing against their own clothes on their avatar before deciding to swap or buy.
sections.closet_page_p1: The Closet page lets you view, search, and manage your digitized garments:
sections.closet_view_desc: Browse all your registered shirts, pants, skirts, shoes, and outerwear in a grid. Filter by color, category, season, or material.
sections.closet_select_desc: Enable select mode to checkmark multiple clothing items and bulk delete them from your wardrobe database in a single action.
sections.closet_group_desc: Combine individual garments into a synchronized Set (like a suit or matching dress sets) to ensure they are suggested together. You can ungroup sets back into single items anytime.
sections.closet_edit_desc: Fine-tune parsed parameters. Manually edit season compatibility, formality tags, primary/secondary colors, fabrics, and custom annotations inside the item's detail editor.
sections.trend_scout_p1: Keep your fashion style ahead of the curve with our daily curated feed:
sections.trend_feed_desc: Receives style suggestions, fashion trends, and articles tailored specifically to match your profile preferences.
sections.trend_buckets_desc: Explore four curated categories: SS26 Runway (latest high-fashion), News Flash (breaking style reports), Recycling (sustainable fashion), and Influencers (social trendsetters).
sections.experts_p1: Connect with real-world fashion experts directly inside DressApp:
sections.experts_dir_desc: Browse a registry of certified professional stylists, fashion advisors, and wardrobe consultants.
sections.experts_search_desc: Filter experts by region, country, or specific fashion specialties.
sections.experts_contact_desc: Reach out directly via phone, send direct emails, or visit their professional portfolios and websites.
sections.expert_campaigns_help_p1: Verfolgen und aktualisieren Sie Ihre geschäftlichen Aktionen in Ihren Experten-Einstellungen:
sections.expert_campaigns_status_desc: Behalten Sie den Überblick, ob Ihre Kampagne ein Entwurf, Ausstehend, Aktiv, Pausiert oder Abgelehnt ist.
sections.expert_campaigns_extend_desc: Lassen Sie eine erfolgreiche Kampagne länger laufen. Verlängerungen werden automatisch abgerechnet und erfordern keine Überprüfung.
sections.expert_campaigns_pause_desc: Verbergen Sie Ihr Angebot vorübergehend, wenn Sie beschäftigt sind. Pausierte Tage werden beim Fortsetzen an das Enddatum angehängt.
sections.expert_campaigns_delete_desc: Löschen Sie Ihre Kampagne jederzeit. Aktive Kampagnen werden sofort ohne Rückerstattung entfernt.
sections.create_campaign_help_p1: Erstellen Sie eine lokale Aktion mit dem einfachen Schritt-für-Schritt-Assistenten:
sections.create_campaign_button_desc: Klicken Sie in Ihrem Dashboard auf 'Neue Kampagne', um den 6-Schritte-Assistenten zu öffnen.
sections.create_campaign_step_desc: Füllen Sie grundlegende Details, Aktionsdaten, Standort, Reichweite, Zielgruppe und Benachrichtigungsoptionen aus.
sections.create_campaign_fee_desc: Abgerechnet zum Festpreis von 1,00 USD pro Tag. Sie müssen Ihre PayPal-E-Mail vor dem Einreichen verbinden.
sections.create_campaign_submit_desc: Nach der PayPal-Zahlung gehen Kampagnen in die Moderationswarteschlange und werden nach der Genehmigung sofort aktiviert.
sections.expected_item1: Your clothes will appear in your digital closet as clean cutouts without backgrounds.
sections.expected_item2: If your clothes were cut off in the photo, the AI will fill in the missing pieces (using Nano Banana reconstruction).
sections.expected_item3: Scanned retail QR tags will show a green badge verifying materials.
sections.expected_item4: Your avatar will display your layered clothes without any visual glitches.
sections.trouble_full_q: Help! My closet is full and I can't add more clothes!
sections.trouble_full_why: Why it happens: Free accounts are limited to 150 items.
sections.trouble_full_fix: Easy fix: 1. Subscribe to the Pro plan, or share your invite link with a friend to get +10 extra spots. 2. Get a free Gemini API key by logging into Google AI Studio.
sections.trouble_cam_why: Why it happens: Your web browser doesn't have permission to use the camera.
sections.trouble_cam_fix: Easy fix: Go to browser settings, allow camera access, and refresh the page.
sections.trouble_slow_q: The app is running slow when I upload multiple pictures!
sections.trouble_slow_why: Why it happens: Processing pictures takes a lot of computer work.
sections.trouble_slow_fix: Easy fix: The app automatically processes them one by one. Just wait a minute!
sections.limit_item1: Voice typing works best on Google Chrome or Apple Safari browsers.
sections.limit_item2: Dark, blurry, or folded clothes might not be recognized correctly by the scanner. Try taking pictures in a bright room with the garment laid flat.
sections.profile_item12_desc: Hier können Sie anpassen, welche lokalen Modeaktionen, Verkäufe und Stylisten-Updates Sie per E-Mail oder Push erhalten. Sie können die Häufigkeit und Entfernung festlegen.
sections.campaigns_help_p1: Finden Sie exklusive Verkäufe, Stylisten-Events und lokale Modeangebote in Ihrer Nähe:
sections.campaigns_feed_help_desc: Durchsuchen Sie eine Live-Liste von Werbekampagnen, die von verifizierten Modeexperten in Ihrer Nähe veröffentlicht wurden.
sections.campaigns_maps_help_desc: Klicken Sie auf ein Angebot, um die Beschreibung anzuzeigen, Rabattcodes zu kopieren und die Boutique direkt auf Google Maps zu finden.
sections.campaigns_save_help_desc: Speichern Sie Ihre bevorzugten lokalen Angebote, um sie später anzusehen, oder teilen Sie sie mit Freunden.
